LanguageData.TDB_EnabledTip: Opens a small TCP server that the TouchDeck plugin "rimworld" connects to.
LanguageData.TDB_AddressHint: 127.0.0.1 = this PC only (recommended). 0.0.0.0 = all network cards, or the IP of one network card. Anything except 127.0.0.1 needs a secret.
LanguageData.TDB_SecretHint: Must be entered the same way in the plugin. Optional for 127.0.0.1, required otherwise (at least 12 characters). The connection is not encrypted.
LanguageData.TDB_Interval: Send state at most every {0} ms
LanguageData.TDB_StatusBlocked: This address can be reached from other computers. The server does not start without a secret of at least {0} characters.
LanguageData.TDB_RemoteWarning: Note: other devices in the network can connect (with the secret). Only use this in your own network, never on the open internet.
LanguageData.TDB_ApplyHint: Changed settings are also applied when you close this window; no game restart needed.
